questions.q: When Rachel said 'Give me children, or else I die,' what did Jacob answer?
choices: Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
questions.explain: They that marry shall have trouble in the flesh (1 Corinthians 7:28).

questions.q: Who opened Rachel's womb so she bare Joseph?
choices: God, who remembered her; not the mandrakes
questions.explain: He maketh the barren woman to keep house and to be a joyful mother of children (Psalms 113:9).

questions.q: What did Laban learn by experience?
choices: The Lord had blessed him for Jacob's sake
questions.explain: With Jacob in his household Laban was increasing.

questions.q: What did Jacob ask Laban for as wages?
choices: Nothing given: only the speckled, spotted and brown cattle from then on
questions.explain: Thou shalt not give me any thing. That is the spirit of the forefathers: provide for your own house, for the Most High provides.

questions.q: What did Jacob mean by 'so shall my righteousness answer for me'?
choices: Laban's sons will speak for me
Judge me on my works: terms set in the open that anyone could check
My vow at Bethel protects me
questions.explain: He knew they were going to have something bad to say about his increase.
